notes.title: Full Version Release in March!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hello Players! 🙌[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Thank you for staying with us for all this time! 

Today we’ve got some exciting news - the full version of Car Mechanic Shop Simulator is ready and will be released on Steam on March 5th, 2025! 🔥[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3401000/Car_Mechanic_Shop_Simulator/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355137/9690b5ded650d753d8bcdcccb16f29949b164c41.png[/img]

[h3]If you don't want to miss the upcoming release and make sure you open your own store on release day, you can [b]Follow[/b] the game now and add it to your [b]Wishlist![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355137/3ec0182e8b356200b848fb1b86c5c3e961246399.gif[/img]


[h3]And if you want to get to know some of the game features, a few days ago we released a demo version that is now available on Steam! 💪[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3401010/Car_Mechanic_Shop_Simulator_Demo/

[url=https://discord.gg/TBQGEJU44W][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355137/357c75611e60db47c4b2339702ca6db4a1ed87cd.png[/img][/url]

See you soon!
Car Mechanic Shop SImulator Team
